Why Indians keep Mauritius clean but not India? #goa #mauritius #tourism
source.description:
Mauritius shows that India can be clean as well

Mauritius is an island nation with 70% population of Indian descent

I was ther last week and 

It was clean

No one litters

Everyone finds and puts their trash in their dustbin

Yes, the population is just 1.3 million with strict municipal laws

And its economy depends on clean beaches and blue water

So you can argue that being clean is a necessity

But that same argument can be put even for Goa which is a mess

What this proves is that Indians are not inherently dirty or lack civic sense

We just need to enforce laws and raise civic awareness

Let's make India clean again

source.title: House of Duality | Official Promo #buildofy #architecture #bengaluru #karnataka #home #shorts
Don’t buy homes with too many amenities #truthmatters #homebuying #vanity
source.description:
Don’t buy home with many amenities

It sounds appealing that your home has amenities that you need. It sounds even more appealing that your home has amenities that you don’t need. 

The truth is that beyond the glamour there is a monthly cost for services you don’t even use. 

Maintenance bills average at ₹10/sqft on carpet area. 

The wise approach is to choose projects with less amenities but those you are more likely to use.

Is Mumbai on Sale? #mumbai #realestate #openspaces #politics #builder
source.description:
Is Mumbai officially on Sale?

That’s the question to ask after the recent municipal corporation move 

To convert a football ground into a convention Center in Bandra 

It’s strange as that is the only true football ground in Mumbai which ought to be protected

Besides a major convention Center already exists 7 kms away

Opposition to the plan was loud

But when arrogance is at a peak 

Then being brazen provides a high like no other 

Unfortunately this is another step in killing open spaces in Mumbai 

The city has the lowest open spaces in the world

And its only going lower 

The city is suffocating and unable to breathe

Mumbai is not treated as a city with people 

But only as Real Estate to be plundered 

It is the hen that lays the golden egg

And it is being slowly slaughtered

source.description:
No Footpaths in Indian cities

There are more footpaths in the old city than in the new city

source.title: Salary of ₹80k/month is almost poverty in Mumbai #homebuying #budget #timing #strategy #bhkvoice
source.description:
A 24-year-old resident with a salary of ₹80,000/month wants to buy a home in Mumbai.

He wants Andheri but lacks the budget. His temptation is to buy a property elsewhere before prices rise. 

My View
1) Don't rush to buy. The myth of home prices rising every year is a..myth
2) Work Hard, Save, Focus on Career. Buy in Andheri, buy late. But buy RIGHT.

source.title: When Andheri was not part of Mumbai #mumbai #bombay #andheri #history #city
source.description:
Andheri is the center of Mumbai today

But did you know not long back

Andheri was not even part of Mumbai

Until 1945 Bombay was very small

Just 67 square kilometers

or just 15% of what it is today

Andheri was then governed by a Collector

And was part of the suburban district

Then in 1945 Greater Bombay was created

And Andheri along with other districts became part of Bombay

80 years later Andheri has become the heart of Mumbai

If your society building is getting older, don't wait for a serious problem to take place.
